captions.detailed: A wall-mounted CCTV security camera assembly consisting of a dark grey rectangular wall plate, a supporting diagonal strut, and a horizontal mounting arm. Suspended from the end of the arm is a light grey dual-axis gimbal mechanism featuring a vertical pan joint and a horizontal tilt joint. A spherical dome camera housing with a dark circular lens ring is mounted at the bottom of the gimbal.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted CCTV camera with a dark grey mounting plate and support arm, supporting a light grey dome camera. The assembly should feature a vertical panning joint and a horizontal tilting joint to allow the camera housing to articulate.
captions.factory: Construct the base wall plate using a box primitive, and append the horizontal arm and diagonal support bracket using box structures. Create a vertical cylindrical hinge point at the end of the arm. Build the gimbal yoke using a combined horizontal bar and vertical side plates, and model the camera housing as a sphere intersected or modified with a cylinder to form the lens bezel. Connect these parts with revolute joints representing the pan and tilt axes.
